description.en: A calcified algal thallus consists of linked flattened segments.
description.zh: 钙化藻体由相连扁平节片组成。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Halimeda; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Halimeda 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Articulated plate chain differs from continuous filamentous or tubular algae, independently of colour or density.
distinctness.zh: 关节相连片链区别于连续丝状或管状藻，与颜色密度无关。

modeling_brief.en: Use a few branched chains of faceted plates with narrow connections; select fossil segment outlines before finalization.
modeling_brief.zh: 用少量带窄连接的分枝折面片链建形，定稿前选择化石节片外形。

uncertainty: Generic reconstruction only; a Cretaceous look-alike must not be assigned a modern species without evidence.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: The calcareous reef alga Halimeda: a Cretaceous genus that diversified in the Cenozoic
sources.supports: Segmented calcified thalli and fossil record.
